title: Oozing Greek Tomatoes Roasted Kleftiko
description: A buttery and flavorful dish featuring roasted grape tomatoes in a form inspired by traditional Greek Kleftiko. This dish is perfect for a weeknight dinner.
instructions: In a large bowl, toss grape tomatoes with olive oil, garlic, salt, and black pepper until they are evenly coated.
Spread the tomatoes in a single layer on a large baking sheet and roast for 20 minutes.
While the tomatoes are roasting, combine balsamic vinegar and roasted red peppers in a small saucepan and bring to a simmer over medium heat.
Reduce the vinegar mixture by half and set aside.
After the tomatoes have roasted for 20 minutes, sprinkle with oregano and return to the oven for an additional 10 minutes.
Remove the tomatoes from the oven and top with basil, lemon zest, and roasted red peppers.
Slice the crusty bread into thick slices and serve alongside the tomatoes.
Cut the feta cheese into small pieces and sprinkle over the top of the tomatoes.
Drizzle the balsamic glaze over the tomatoes and serve immediately.
Garnish with additional oregano and basil if desired.
